_readme: The prompts the app sends. One live prompt per task; edit the .txt files to change it (applies on the next AI call, no restart). 'version' is the label stored on each research run, used for caching and history: bump it when the prompt meaningfully changes. Earlier versions and how they were refined: docs/llm_experiments/. Placeholders in {braces} are filled by code; literal braces in judge.user.txt are doubled {{ }}.

research.note: Standard research narrowed to the 5 routing-relevant basics (industry, locations, employees, funding, hiring). Travel, expansion and support complexity move to Deep Research. Company-stated rounded headcounts count as figures.

deep.note: Deep Research: comprehensive second pass over all 8 fields, reusing what is already known. Compares signup inputs with public research (source dates, estimates, different entities) and separates explicit business-travel requirements from indirect growth signals.

repair.note: Sent once when the AI's JSON fails validation.

judge.note: AI judge: one-sentence why, support level, main doubt. v2 requires 'rests on X, evidence shows Y, so Tier Z'. v3 explains the case FOR the proposal from its basis (Day 30 activity vs signup evidence) and caps Day 30 support at partial. v4: Day 30 example is Tier 3 -> Tier 2 (Day 30 no longer proposes Tier 1).
